video_file: Doing The Whole Group Project? Do These 5 Things.mp4
caption:
Group project and somehow you're the whole group? At the sandcastle challenge, Sol and the Narrator fix it with five things: split the project into small pieces, put one name on each piece, set a deadline before the real deadline, keep everything in one doc the whole team can see, and ask one specific person instead of "can someone." Ignite's free Social Impact & Project Development course teaches you how to take an idea and actually make it happen.
